title: Snuggle Down and Think of Him
story: Thinking of Heavenly Father at Night
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A song-writer loved God so much
He thought of Him in bed,
'I think of You when I lie down,
And rest my sleepy head.'

[Chorus]
Tonight I snuggle down to sleep,
And think of God above,
I feel Him close, all through the night,
Remembering His love.

[Verse 2]
'I want You near the way I want
Cool water when I'm dry,'
He thought of all the good God did,
Beneath the quiet sky.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and snuggle down,
The world is quiet, still,
Take one glad thought of God to sleep,
He's close, and always will.

[Chorus]
mood: Cradle music. A slow, tender rock, side to side like a bed gently swaying, matching a story about lying still at night and thinking of God. The pulse is barely there, soft and unhurried, leaving room for a child's own quiet thoughts. By the last verse it drifts lower and slower until the sway nearly stops and sleep takes over.
